title: Elemental reference for carbon
statement:
Which carbon sample has zero standard formation enthalpy at the usual 298 K reference conditions?

[_]{a}

explanations: A different elemental allotrope need not have zero formation enthalpy.
Isolated gaseous atoms are not the reference state.

hints: The zero applies to the elemental reference form.
Check the phase or form as well as the element.
solution: The reference form of elemental carbon at these conditions is graphite.
